conversation.transcript:
Student: Hi, do you know when the cultural festival is happening?
Advisor: Yes, it's scheduled for this weekend, starting Saturday. 
Student: Oh great! What time does it start?
Advisor: It begins at 10 AM. You should come early to get a good spot!

announcement.transcript: Attention students, the annual cultural festival will be held this Saturday from 10 AM to 6 PM in the main courtyard. There will be various performances, food stalls, and activities for everyone. Don't miss out on this exciting event!

talk.transcript: Today, I'm going to talk about the importance of cultural festivals. These events not only celebrate diversity but also foster community engagement. They provide a platform for artists to showcase their work and for attendees to experience different cultures through music, food, and art. Additionally, cultural festivals often involve educational workshops that offer insights into various traditions. By participating, individuals can gain a deeper appreciation for cultures different from their own, promoting understanding and respect among different communities.

questions.q: What is one main purpose of cultural festivals?
questions.explain: 文化節的主要目的是慶祝多元文化。

questions.q: What type of activities are included in cultural festivals?
questions.explain: 文化節包括音樂、美食和藝術活動。

questions.q: What benefit do educational workshops provide?
questions.explain: 教育工作坊能提供文化的見解。

questions.q: How do cultural festivals promote community understanding?
questions.explain: 文化節通過提供文化體驗來促進社區理解。
